commands: redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p $REDIS_PORT PING 2>/dev/null | grep -qi pong && echo 'Redis OK' || { echo 'Redis PING failed - check connectivity'; exit 1; }
echo '=== Step 2: Check Redis MUC DB size before flush ==='
echo '=== Step 3: Show top-5 largest keys before flush ==='

redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p $REDIS_PORT -n $MUC_DB --scan 2>/dev/null | head -200 | while read k; do sz=$(redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p $REDIS_PORT -n $MUC_DB STRLEN "$k" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "$sz $k"; done | sort -rn | head -5 || echo 'scan skipped'
echo '=== Step 4: Flush Redis MUC DB (DB 1) ==='
redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p $REDIS_PORT -n $MUC_DB FLUSHDB 2>/dev/null && echo 'MUC DB flushed OK' || echo 'FLUSHDB failed'
echo '=== Step 5: Also flush session DB (DB 0) stale lock keys ==='

redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p $REDIS_PORT -n 0 --scan --pattern '*lock*' 2>/dev/null | head -50 | while read k; do redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p $REDIS_PORT -n 0 DEL "$k" 2>/dev/null; done; echo 'Session locks cleared'
echo '=== Step 6: Find MUC config file ==='
echo 'MUC config file not found - it will be regenerated'
echo '=== Step 7: Disable compression in MUC config if present ==='
# Replace any compressor setting that isn't 'none'
grep -n 'compressor' "$MUC_CFG" || echo '(no compressor setting found - default is none)'
echo '=== Step 8: Run Moodle CLI cache purge ==='
systemctl restart php-fpm && echo 'php-fpm restarted OK' || echo 'php-fpm restart failed'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'login: HTTP:%{http_code} Time:%{time_total}s' --max-time 15 'https://elearning.tsin.ca/login/index.php' 2>/dev/null || echo 'curl to elearning failed'
echo '=== Done: Redis MUC flushed, compression disabled, services restarted ==='
echo 'NOTE: If the OOM error recurs, check the MUC admin config at:'
echo '      Admin > Site admin > Plugins > Caching > Configuration'
